notes.title: How to force the game to run in Windows Mode [2019-1-20]
notes.notes:
The developer has spent hours to locate the bug. Unfortunately, the reason is still not yet found. These are the fixes trying to solve the problem.
[olist]
    [*]In the "Option" menu, all inputs are blocked for 1.5 seconds when the Screen Mode is changed.
    [*]The logic of mouse is improved to avoid potential misoperation.
[/olist]

If you still cannot make the game run in Windows Mode, try this temporal solution:
[olist]
    [*]Go to the folder of the game.
    [*]Find a file called [b]“Config.txt”[/b]. Open it with notepad. (This file should be in the same folder with [b]"Party.exe"[/b])
    [*]Find the item [b]“isFullScreen”[/b]. Change the value from [b]"true"[/b] to [b]"false"[/b]
    [*]Save and close the file [b]“Config.txt”[/b].
    [*]Start the game. It should run in the Windows Mode now.
[/olist]

For some reason, if you still cannot run the game in Windows mode, please leave a message to me. You can significantly help me locate the problem by describing what you did and the behavior of the game.
